purpose: Create a durable measurement framework for the weekly Histórias de Gestão longform franchise across YouTube, LinkedIn and Instagram derivatives without comparing raw cross-platform totals as if they were equivalent.

baselinePolicy.comparisonAfterBaseline: compare each episode to the median of the previous four comparable episodes by platform and format
doNotUse: arbitrary fixed view targets before four episodes
raw cross-platform view comparisons without context

linkedinExecutiveVideo.role: authority and executive relevance, not raw reach parity with YouTube

instagramStoriesOfManagement.role: discovery and franchise awareness; use a native vertical derivative rather than a simple mirror of the YouTube or LinkedIn master

decisionRules: If watch minutes rise but average percentage viewed falls materially, inspect duration/pacing before increasing length.
If average percentage viewed is healthy but total views are weak, investigate packaging/distribution before changing the editorial thesis.
If Instagram shares+saves outperform the account's recent Reel median, keep Histórias de Gestão as a recurring Instagram franchise.
If LinkedIn interactions are low but watch quality and comments are high, preserve the executive cut and avoid optimizing only for impressions.
Do not declare a winner between platforms using raw views alone.
